question: Can the M2 grading recital in §2903.16(C)(2) apply to any violation of (B)? Division (B) already requires resulting serious physical harm, while (C)(2) makes the violation F4 when that same harm results. Confirm whether an M2 outcome exists, or how the reckless branch must be described.
decision: Yes, my reading is that by definition any act implcating C(2) requires serious physical harm and thus must be a 4th degree felony. The provision could have been drafted better,

question: Which authority governs the email/computer predicate in §2923.01(A)? It cites §2923.421, which the official publisher reports as unavailable, while the named offenses are codified in §2913.421. May §2913.421 supply this conspiracy predicate and its grading, or must that application remain withheld?
decision: Yes, the correct definition appears in 2913.421
